description: Create and activate a one-time or recurring human QA template for a target URL. Set cadence to custom with cadenceDays from 1-30 for a custom interval. Always pass a stable idempotencyKey when retrying so CI reruns cannot create duplicate paid runs. Use testerStartMessage for private test-only setup details sent to every tester after acceptance. Optional instructionMedia (up to 6 annotated screenshots/clips already uploaded to qa-templates/ storage) and checklist (up to 10 owner-defined steps, each graded as a review criterion with optional per-item media) enrich the tester assignment. Use applicantScreening.liveVideoRequired, applicantScreening.linkedinRequired, and applicantScreening.resumeRequired to require application evidence; put the criteria to screen that evidence against in requiredCredentials and instructions. Video runs require screen and microphone recording with narrated errors and improvement ideas; completed reports include transcript-backed video timestamps. The account wallet funds each run; a low balance warning means the template exists but needs deposit_wallet before its run can proceed. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

allowedCountries.description: an array of at most 30 item(s)
allowedCountries.title: maxItems(30)

applicantScreening.description: Optional application requirements: liveVideoRequired records a live camera video, linkedinRequired requires a LinkedIn profile, and resumeRequired requires an uploaded PDF, DOCX, or TXT resume. All default to false. Screening compares submitted evidence with requiredCredentials and task instructions.

autoMode.description: Defaults to true. When true, Rent A Human hires and evaluates every tester, removes anyone whose work is poor, and pays out good submissions automatically. Set false to have every hiring and payout decision escalated to you instead.

budgetPerRunCents.description: a number less than or equal to 500000

cadenceDays.description: Required when cadence is custom. Number of days between QA runs (1-30).
cadenceDays.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(30)

checklist.description: Optional owner-defined checklist steps testers must cover; each becomes a graded review criterion.

id.description: Stable lowercase id unique across checklist items. Omit to have the server derive one.
